request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for Year 2 maintenance and enhancement, including part-time maintainer coverage, SDK/spec maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The maintainer funding is described as 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
UTxO RPC provides an open interface specification for UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language-specific SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 open-source license.

The work scope includes maintaining protocol compatibility, SDK dependencies, performance, bug fixes, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, feedback-driven enhancements, and public developer communication.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal asserts that the requested amount does not breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Funds are to be administered through Intersect using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization thresholds, oversight entities, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for TxPipe's UTxO RPC maintenance through Intersect-administered smart contracts, presenting a 12-month maintenance scope, ecosystem adoption assertions, Intersect budget-process support, NCL compliance, prior funding history, and oversight mechanisms.
